en-US.promotionalText: See more, side by side. Explore 120 art and design styles with Guided Looking, flexible layouts, daily reminders and Home Screen widgets.
en-US.whatsNew:
More room to look, without losing your place.

- Guided Looking places artwork and prompts side by side in wider windows. Compact screens keep the focused single-column experience.
- Rotate your iPhone or resize an iPad window while keeping your reading passage and current guide step.
- Improved safe-area spacing and large-text controls in landscape.

Also in V1.6: optional daily style reminders at 9:00 AM, small and medium Home Screen widgets, and iPad portrait, landscape and Split View support. Style Atlas Plus offers monthly auto-renewal and an annual plan with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. Existing legacy Plus purchases remain recognized.
en-US.descriptionAddition: Layouts adapt to the space available. On wider screens, Guided Looking shows artwork and prompts side by side. Rotation and window resizing preserve your reading passage and guide step. iPhone supports portrait and landscape; iPad supports portrait, landscape and Split View.

zh-Hans.promotionalText: 屏幕更宽，看得更完整。探索 120 种艺术与设计风格，让作品与看图引导并排呈现；旋转或调整窗口后继续阅读，还有每日风格提醒与桌面小组件。
zh-Hans.whatsNew:
多一点空间，看图不丢思路。

- 宽屏下，作品与看图引导并排显示；窄屏保持专注的单栏体验。
- iPhone 支持横竖屏，iPad 调整窗口时保留当前阅读段落与导览步骤。
- 优化横屏安全区域间距，以及大字号下的导览操作。

V1.6 同时带来：可选的每日 9:00 风格提醒、小号与中号桌面小组件，以及 iPad 横竖屏和分屏支持。Style Atlas Plus 提供按月自动续订与按年自动续订方案，符合条件的新订阅者可享年度方案 7 天免费试用。既有 Plus 购买权益继续有效。

reviewNotes:
Style Atlas V1.6 (16) contains 120 art and design styles with 120 complete bilingual in-depth guides. No account or sign-in is required. iPhone now supports portrait and both landscape orientations; iPad retains portrait, landscape and Split View. Layout follows available window width, with side-by-side artwork and Guided Looking prompts on wider screens. Width changes preserve the reading paragraph and active guide step without recreating the web document. Large-text guide controls remain scrollable in short landscape windows. No hardware-model detection or fold-angle API is used.

The daily reminder is opt-in and uses local notifications at 9:00 AM device time. Small and medium Home Screen widgets open the corresponding daily style.

Suggested review path:
1. Open any style and browse the Hero and introduction.
2. Open Guided Looking, move to the next step, and rotate the device. On iPad, resize the window; the step should remain unchanged.
3. Read an interior guide paragraph, then rotate or resize. The reading position should remain near that paragraph.
4. Tap a Plus-locked section or Open the complete style archive. The Annual Subscription is selected by default. Eligible new subscribers see a 7-day free trial, then yearly auto-renewal until cancelled.
5. Select Monthly Subscription to test monthly auto-renewal. Test Restore Purchases, language switching, favorites and export ratios.
6. Add a small or medium widget, and enable the daily reminder in the app to test the local notification flow.

Products submitted with this version:
- xiazishuo_style_atlas_plus_monthly_auto
- xiazishuo_style_atlas_plus_annual_auto
Legacy products remain recognized only for existing purchasers:
- xiazishuo_style_atlas_plus_annual
- xiazishuo_style_atlas_plus_lifetime

The purchase screen offers only monthly and annual auto-renewing options. Purchases use StoreKit / the App Review test environment; no test account is required. No subscription prices or entitlement rules changed in build 16.
